adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` to `.env.example` (new APP CREDENTIAL SYNC section) but does not document what Cal.com will POST to that endpoint or what shape it must return. The contract is only hinted in code comments in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts` (POST form fields `calcomUserId` and `appSlug`) and `parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts` (expects at least `access_token` and a numeric expiry field when syncing is enabled). This is a concrete docs gap in the env example, not a functional defect.
